title: 2 PCG personnel injured in Zamboanga explosion

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Two Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) personnel were injured Saturday night in an alleged accidental explosion inside their barracks at the Zamboanga City International Pier, the PCG said on Sunday. The incident occurred at around 10:39 p.m. on Oct. 24 at the Explosive Ordnance Disposal Unit-Southwestern Mindanao barracks within the Port Police Compound along Corcuera Street in the Port Area. “Reports revealed that the personnel were preparing for the upcoming Explosive Ordnance Reconnaissance Agent Training when an accidental detonation of explosive lecture material-low explosive occurred,” the PCG said in a statement.
